name: qq-dld
description: QQ 大乐斗自动任务系统 (开发中)

scripts.start: concurrently -k -n "API,WEB" -c "cyan,green" "cross-env JWT_SECRET=dev-secret-do-not-use-in-prod npm run start --workspace=@qq-dld/server" "npm run dev --workspace=@qq-dld/web"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "API,WEB" -c "cyan,green" "cross-env JWT_SECRET=dev-secret-do-not-use-in-prod npm run start --workspace=@qq-dld/server" "npm run dev --workspace=@qq-dld/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@qq-dld/shared && npm run build --workspace=@qq-dld/server && npm run build --workspace=@qq-dld/web
